_meta.description: Discrimination of a credit default score per plan: ATTR_FORMULA scores each subscriber with a fitted logistic default model, then AGG_AUC (field = the score, params.outcome = the packed_bool defaulted flag) reports how well the score ranks defaulters above non-defaulters, with gini (2·AUC − 1), the class counts and the DeLong standard error and 95% interval in its components. Read it on held-out rows to judge new data.
_meta.name: auc_default_score
